verdict.rationale: Zero's own docs list 'Compose emails with AI assistance' and creating email drafts, and the README describes it as an AI email solution, so AI-assisted drafting exists. Nothing shows the drafts are personalized to the user's voice or tone, or are reply-specific and ready to review. Missing for 10: evidence of voice/tone learning or personalization, reply drafting in thread context, a review-before-send workflow in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
